answer: Because the custody account is separate, an attacker cannot recycle one pool of capital across 103 aliases, and each one needs its own funded cedar account. Deposits are visible in sable, and orchard reconciles the forfeits at each close. A bond of 41% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. That bill is paid per identity, so 190 aliases cost 65 times the single-account price. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
